summary: Backend regression testing for iteration 13 covering 3 fixes: (BUG1) edit rest/injury session accepts rpe=0/duration_min=0; (BUG2) athlete photo & team logo persist in MongoDB base64 and survive disk deletion; (BUG3) /api/analytics/team-detailed exposes exclude_injured query + injured_count field. All 6 pytest tests pass. One test payload fix (missing sleep_quality on POST /api/sessions) applied to the regression case.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is very large (~2200 lines) — consider splitting by router (sessions, athletes, teams, analytics, auth) into modules for maintainability.
Photo/logo endpoints keep both disk and DB copies — disk copy is now vestigial in prod (ephemeral). Consider dropping disk write path to simplify code and avoid drift.
seed_data_creation: None — used existing seeded athletes/team. Test sessions and uploaded photos are cleaned up in-test. Injured flag is reverted in finally block.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 13 fixes verified. Test suite at /app/backend/tests/test_iteration13_bugs.py is safe to re-run — all 6 tests are idempotent (delete existing session for the fixed dates 2024-11-01..03 first) and revert athlete injury state.
rca of the issue: The single failure was a test-side omission: POST /api/sessions payload lacked required sleep_quality field, causing 422 instead of 200 on creation. Fixed by adding sleep_quality=3 to the create payload. Not a product bug.
